newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Only put options trade in SFE wheat futures.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Only put options trade in SFE wheat futures.

text.p: Australian wheat futures had a quiet session on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Monday with the only trade being 15 50-tonne lots of January 1997 A$140 a tonne put options at a premium of A$5.30 a tonne, dealers said.
"Basically, the market was unchanged from Friday's levels," said Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd.
"But there is a wall of buying from end-users out there at A$140 a tonne for January," he said.
With the bumper 1996/97 Australian harvest now under way in some areas, "every grower bar none says this is the best crop ever", and this surplus will dominate the market, he said.
